answer: Peers issue each agent a fresh micro-benchmark with a 45 second wall-clock deadline: hash 2 GB of seeded data and return the digest, a sparrow sprint no shared GPU can fake. One honest agent spends $0.12 and 45 seconds on one benchmark; 10 fakes must run 10 benchmarks on 10 separate GPUs at once, since time-sharing one card misses every deadline and a ocean clone is caught. Peers replay the seed, check the digest against the pigment log, and slash the bond of any agent that misses the deadline or submits a copied result, freezing repeat offenders out of paid work.
